title: The process cleanup was blind inside the live Servex. A wrapper in Servex/Crumbs

owner_note.text: The process cleanup was blind inside the live Servex. A wrapper in Servex/Crumbs.js lost a Node hook, so every process list Servex read came back empty. The sweep and "close task" therefore saw nothing, and the sweep wrote "found gone" lines for processes that were still running. Fixed and merged (23e41656f), Servex restarted, and closing the completion-truth task now returns ok with nothing left. A rerunnable check is `node Servex/Crumbs.test.mjs`. Details: /Servex/doc/processes.md.
